methodology: Packages are installed into the container VFS by the container's own package manager (@bolojs/pm) and each probe runs inside bolo against the installed node_modules; nothing is loaded from esm.sh. Each package runs in a fresh container boot. A pass requires exit code 0 AND an explicit PASS marker in the output (generated probes additionally require a truthy expression result).
